name: @codex/proxy-app-platform
description: Toolkit, SDK and examples for Proxy platform applications

scripts.design:pack: npm run design:build && npm run app -- pack apps/design dist/design.zip
scripts.chat:pack: npm run chat:build && npm run app -- pack apps/chat dist/chat.zip
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @codex/proxy-app-cli && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @codex/proxy-app-sdk
scripts.build: npm run sdk:build && npm run example:build && npm run idea:build && npm run chat:build && npm run design:build && npm run example:validate && npm run idea:validate && npm run chat:validate && npm run design:validate
scripts.test: npm run sdk:build && node --test cli/*.test.mjs && npm run design:test && npm run example:build && npm run idea:build && npm run chat:build && npm run design:build && npm run example:validate && npm run idea:validate && npm run chat:validate && npm run design:validate
